title: Unhinged Crafts Season 2 'Intro to Plasma' - Episode 2 - Lamp Shade Craft
description:
Welcome to Season 2 of ‘Unhinged Crafts’ with Rae Ripple Presented by Northern Tool + Equipment.

Where we make things…
probably not the “right” way,
but definitely a way that works.

This isn’t Pinterest. This is sparks, trial and error, and figuring it out mid-cut. (Literally)

Big builds, small builds, shop builds, “why did I make this?” builds, if it involves tools, and a Hypertherm Plasma, we’re doing it.

In this episode: IT’S MORE PLASMA! We go over more cutting basics and shapes. How to hold the torch, cut clean lines (or at least try to), and not completely destroy your project in the process. 

Up Next, we're crawling. Turning basis shapes into flowers! (My favorite) We would normally scroll through scrap alley, but not today! Sometimes you'll find your next project in a yard sale or in this case The Goodwill. It can be anything from a trashcan to an old rusty tool box. Imagination is everything! 

If you’ve ever wanted to make something but didn’t know where to start, start here. I know you'll love it!

Subscribe, follow along, and tell me what we’re building next: 

A knight's helmet?
Mouse door?
Something mildly concerning?

Doesn’t matter.
We’ll make it. 🔥

​⁠@hypertherm coming soon to a ​⁠@Northern_Tool store near you.

https://www.hypertherm.com/landing-pages/introducing-the-powermax-33-xp/
https://www.northerntool.com/?srsltid=AfmBOoqPD5zxL4ZnEAAGrGUQthtXQsKf6pAph3mePyZksWyHjgUU0eqZ
